description: Golden traces of the shipped stride gate, recorded from the pre-configuration implementation (aa293011: StrideRhythm.ts + MotionAdapter.ts) and replayed by every capture segment. Exact — not rounded — so the shipped defaults stay byte-identical: a diff here means the proven detection behaviour changed.
generator: git show aa293011:app-next/src/runtime/detection/StrideRhythm.ts and .../MotionAdapter.ts, then pushed every segment in fixtures/strideRhythmCaptures.json through the old and the new analyzer/adapter and recorded the old output (see the accompanying test for the replay harness).
analyzer: Per capture: every non-null `push()` assessment, JSON round-tripped, with the sample time added as `t`. The rows are the old implementation’s output.
adapter: Per capture: every `MotionEvidence` published and the final `reconcile()` row, with a 130 steps/min pedometer over the last 9 s, from a default-constructed MotionAdapter.
